## About

This image contains the AKS Periscope application, which can be used to collect detailed diagnostic information for AKS clusters.

## Featured Tags

- `docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/aks/periscope:latest`
- `docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/aks/periscope-win:latest`

## Related Repositories

- [AKS Periscope](https://github.com/Azure/aks-periscope)

## Configuration

This image is designed to be run in a DaemonSet inside an AKS cluster. The [kustomize spec](https://github.com/Azure/aks-periscope/blob/master/deployment/base/kustomization.yaml) shows the configuration options and required secrets.

Since AKS Periscope uploads its logs to an Azure Storage account, the account details and SAS Key must be provided.

## Usage

AKS Periscope can be deployed as a `kustomize` template, as described in the project [README](https://github.com/Azure/aks-periscope/blob/master/README.md#dependent-consuming-tools-and-working-contract).

For a more streamlined deployment experience, AKS Periscope can also be launched from:
- the VS Code [AKS extension](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/azure/aksextensions)
- the `az aks kollect` [command](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/aks?view=azure-cli-latest#az-aks-kollect) in the `az` CLI [tool](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/) (with `aks-preview` extension)
